jugūmentum, jugūmentī n.

noun, second declension

Examples

  • parietēs omnēs, utī jussitur, calce et caementīs; pīlās ex lapide angulārī; tigna omnia quae opus sunt; līmina, postēs, jugūmenta, asserēs

    all the walls, as ordered, of lime and rubble; the pillars of squared stone; all the timbers needed; thresholds, doorposts, lintels, rafters (quoted in Libellus VII)Cato, Agr. 14, 1

See also threshold, doorpost, rafter, beam, rubble.
